control_device_fabrication: The PCE reached for the device was 17.059%, with a JSC of 21.189 mA/cm², a VOC of 1.0245 V and an FF of 78.585%. The 1.73 mol/L perovskite precursor solution with a chemical formula of Cs0.05MA0.16FA0.79I2.9Br0.1 was prepared. SAM material Me-4PACz (0.33 mg/mL) was added to influence crystal growth at the interface and optimize surface passivation.  The chosen spin-coating regimen first applied 1000 rpm for 10 s, then 5000 rpm for 30 s, ensuring layer consistency. The controlled addition of 160 µL antisolvent at last 6 s facilitated uniform crystal nucleation. The perovskite film was obtained by annealing at 110 °C for 25 min.
target_device_fabrication: The PCE reached for the device was 18.7619%, with a JSC of 23.8616 mA/cm², a VOC of 1.06191 V and an FF of 74.0439%. For the perovskite composition Cs0.05MA0.16FA0.79I2.9Br0.1, 1.73 mol/L perovskite precursor solution was prepared. The hole transport layer (HTL) was fabricated using the SAM solution of Me-4PACz. The Me-4PACz concentration is 0.33 mg/mL. Then 5.0 mg/mL MACl was added to the perovskite precursor solution and stirred for 2 h. The perovskite solutions were spin-coated onto the substrate at 1000 rpm for 10 s and 5000 rpm for 30 s. 160 µL CB as antisolvent was dropped 6 s before the end of the spin-coating procedure. The as-coated film was then annealed at 110 °C for 25 min.
